purpose: Bounded source-only baseline recovery; preserves prior independent outputs
exposure_note: No participant records or outcome tables consulted for this task. AMR PDF reads were limited to dictionary descriptions/value labels and questionnaire pp1-8; prior codebook-summary exposure is disclosed in expanded_b_notes.txt.

records.source_wording: No proposal directly concerning incentives for development of a new antibiotic class found among Q6-Q12 / 45 proposals.
source_locators: dp_data/data/amr-2024/codebooks/harmonized-codebook.pdf: Time value labels 0=pre, 1=post (descriptions and value labels only)
records.rationale_and_limit: The fact about the last new marketed class is relevant to development, but the existing policy battery does not provide an exact development-incentive preference. Q13.2 confidence that experts will solve resistance is a belief, not a development policy. Do not substitute availability of existing basic antibiotics or generic surveillance funding.

records.source_wording: Awareness campaigns should focus on the risks and harms of taking unnecessary antibiotics on humans, food security, and the environment.
source_locators: dp_data/data/amr-2024/codebooks/harmonized-codebook.pdf: Time value labels 0=pre, 1=post (descriptions and value labels only)
dp_data/data/amr-2024/questionnaires/survey-and-extended-data.pdf: PDF p.6 Q10.3; 0 strongly oppose, 10 strongly support, 5 middle
records.rationale_and_limit: The fact includes adverse effects, allergy and absence of antiviral benefit, directly relevant to awareness of unnecessary-use harms. This is a measured awareness-campaign preference, narrower than a general stewardship or prescribing restriction axis. It is not an identity proxy.

records.source_wording: National governments should prioritise infection prevention tools (clean water, safe sanitation and vaccination) to reduce the burden of infectious diseases.
source_locators: dp_data/data/amr-2024/codebooks/harmonized-codebook.pdf: Time value labels 0=pre, 1=post (descriptions and value labels only)
records.rationale_and_limit: Despite the verb prioritise, the RESPONSE scale is explicit 0 strongly oppose to 10 strongly support, not an importance-only scale. Knowledge options support prevention effectiveness. Retain the documented Q21 conflict: English questionnaire repeats other options, whereas inventory/codebook carry prevention options; country field forms remain unrecovered.

records.source_wording: As a member state, should Britain's relationship with the European Union be less close, about right, or closer?
source_locators: dp_data/data/uk-eu-1995/codebook.txt: line1685 RELEU1 Q1 SAQ1 stem; distributions not read
records.rationale_and_limit: Tax autonomy supplies an autonomy reassurance for a closer relationship. This baseline is closeness conditional on membership, not an actual membership/withdrawal vote; reframe the axis explicitly. taxes1 is an alternative competence preference (1 mostly EU,2 equally,3 countries), but retained national tax authority does not automatically favor transferring tax authority to the EU.

records.source_wording: Making Election Day a national holiday
source_locators: dp_data/data/btp-2007/value-labels.csv: PRE_Q5a 1 favor strongly,2 favor somewhat,3 neither,4 oppose somewhat,5 oppose strongly
records.rationale_and_limit: Half turnout establishes a participation problem but does not establish that a holiday fixes it. PRE_Q5a is a possible specific baseline, not an interchangeable generic pro-participation measure; treat this as an interpretation-dependent sensitivity only. PRE_Q5b election-day registration and PRE_Q5e nonvoter fines are different interventions.

records.source_wording: No exact baseline preference for visa-overstay enforcement relative to border control recovered.
source_locators: dp_data/data/europolis-2009/questionnaires/master-questionnaire-2009.pdf: PDF p.1 wave labels; p.5 Q11
records.rationale_and_limit: Reinforcing borders is not exclusive reliance on border-only enforcement. Overstay prevalence does not uniquely contradict strengthening border checks, so do not silently use opposition to strengthening as support for overstay enforcement. V2 knowledge is ARRIVAL before deliberation, not post-event; V3Q48 also exists.

alternative.limitation: Verified policy scale but not an exact overstay-versus-border-only contrast; requires a newly adjudicated axis/direction.

records.source_wording: How much priority should be given to investing more in renewable sources like wind, hydro, wave and solar?
source_locators: dp_data/data/europolis-2009/questionnaires/master-questionnaire-2009.pdf: PDF p.1 T2 arrival; PDF p.7 Q27.5
records.rationale_and_limit: V2Q27_5 is a pre-deliberation arrival priority rating, not support/oppose, and bundles renewables rather than wind alone. Low priority does not equal favoring less wind; use only a separately defined priority-moderation analysis or recover a bipolar preference. Earlier screening warnings about V2 being post-only were overbroad and are corrected here.

alternative.scale: 0 no priority at all;5 exactly middle;10 highest priority
alternative.positive_negative_binary: Not defined: importance/priority cannot be interpreted as a bipolar preference.
